name: The Ember Knight
notes: DRAFT for C13-6 (bestiary-plan.md; lore from drafts/content/lore/guardians-and-relics.json, unchanged). Red Guardian on floor 5. Same shape as content/enemies/floor-keeper.json, plus phases (66% and 33%, Manager's call). Stats are TODO for the Researcher. Faith tie-ins stay out until Jay decides; see faithOverlayKey.

attacks.name: shield bash
attacks.note: Raises its shield, then bumps forward in a short red circle.

phases.tell: Its blade glows bright; red circle.
phases.senseiLine: Glow first, then the swing. Wait.

phases.tell: It lowers its shield; a striped lane and double marks.
phases.senseiLine: A shield can't turn fast. DASH.

phases.tell: Sparks fly; the lane comes right after a slash.
phases.counterplay: COUNTER, then get ready to DASH.
phases.senseiLine: One answer, then the next. Steady.

lines.intro: The forge is hot. Its knight stands guard alone.
lines.freed: I was guarding the wrong thing. Shields are for helping.
lines.senseiAfter: Strength is best used to protect others.

description: The Ember Knight slashes with a glowing blade, bashes with its shield, then rushes down a striped lane.

bestiary.tip: Glow means COUNTER. Stripes mean DASH.

lore.red: A knight of glowing metal. The shadow told it to protect the forge from everyone. Free it, and its light comes home.
